note: RFC 9687 Section 5 permits a Send Hold Timer Expired NOTIFICATION but requires the connection closed when no BGP message is sent within SendHoldTime. Both tagged functions were re-read. SendHoldExpiryRunsTheEvent29ActionList advances exactly the isolated SendHold deadline without sending, now requires exact ErrSendHoldTimerExpired and uses requireConnClosed to demand EOF/closed pipe, never a timeout; NoSendHoldExpiryLeavesTheSessionIntact advances one nanosecond short and requires no close and Established state. sendHoldTimerExpired closes through closeConn and Run has a common deferred close. The optional NOTIFICATION assertion in the positive unit is additional implementation behavior on a writable pipe, not a mandatory interpretation of MAY. Its sentinel addition removes no transport assertion. No native observation claimed.
